users.title: Users and rights
users.subtitle: Only Admin can add users and grant special rights · every change goes to the user log
users.emptyBody: A person appears here once their sign-in account exists. Use Add user to see how.
users.noAccess: You don't have the right to see users. Ask Admin.
users.notReady: The user tables are not set up on this database yet.
users.loadFailed: Could not load the users. Reload the page; if it happens again, ask Admin.

signInNote.everyoneText: WhatsApp number + password; a WhatsApp code on a new phone.
signInNote.adminText: email or WhatsApp number, password and a code every time.
signInNote.kyc: A login turns on once the WhatsApp number is in staff KYC.

addUser.title: Add a user
addUser.lead: Sign-in accounts are created with the Supabase admin key, which never goes to the browser. Admin creates the account in one of two ways:
addUser.dashboard: In the Supabase dashboard: Authentication → Users → Add user. Enter the WhatsApp number or email and a password, and tick auto-confirm.
addUser.edge: Or through the admin-users function, once it is deployed.
addUser.after: The account then appears on this screen by itself (the database makes its profile). Give it a role with Add role on its row.

edit.title: Edit user
edit.help: Every change is kept in the user log.
edit.name: Display name
edit.personCodeHelp: Staff ID from payroll, if any

assign.title: Add a role for {{name}}
assign.help: The role's rights apply at once. The reason goes into the user log.
assign.validToHelp: Required for CA and auditor; leave empty for others
assign.validToErr: CA and auditor access needs an end date.
assign.reasonErr: Say why, in at least 5 characters.

remove.title: Remove role
remove.effect: Removes the {{role}} role ({{scope}}) from {{name}}. Their menus and rights from this role stop at once. Recorded in the user log.

matrix.title: {{role}} role · starting rights
matrix.sub: Applies to everyone with this role · for one person, give a special permission
matrix.fixed: Owner, Admin, CA and auditor are not listed: their rights are fixed by their view.
matrix.caption: Module rights for the role
matrix.readOnly: Only Admin can change role rights.
matrix.noRoles: No roles are set up on this database yet.

special.title: Special rights
special.lead: Only Admin can grant these. To give one for a set time with limits, use
special.reasonPh: e.g. handles GST filing from next month
special.otpNote: Admin code on WhatsApp arrives in Phase 3.
